meta.title: Recreate Order: Attempt to create order with Delivery Date not selected
gaps: Open Vendor A's bid-row ⋮ menu and choose Settings → Recreate Order; the catalog only opens Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open Vendor A's bid-row ⋮ menu and choose Settings → Recreate Order; the catalog only opens Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ with one invited vendor bid.
Open the RFQ Responses tab containing the vendor bid.
Open the Recreate Order window using the available RFQ Settings action.
Confirm the Recreate Order window opened.
Set the requested event end-time duration.
Submit the form while deliberately leaving Delivery Date empty.
Verify creation is blocked by the delivery-date validation message.
Verify the validation leaves the Recreate Order window open.
